scope: Native touch/interception/controlled-owner/guard/cancellation cohort using the existing Link scene unchanged. This is queued preparation for an OPEN cell, not new passing-cell evidence or whole-cell closure.
preparationPolicy: Reuse an existing public scene and its six source checks. No new app scenario, observer, harness, source API, process monitor or passing-cell backfill is needed.
isolation: Only this Swift fixture and criterion map are added. App/harness/editor/production/other lane files and all original tests, ledgers, source-case limits, dependency pins and acceptance criteria remain unchanged.

admission.source: Main binds full integration HEAD plus actual source/product/SDK/input/profile tuple. The scene hash and manifest environment variables describe admission inputs and never stand in for native execution proof.
admission.beforeEachMethod: Coordinator prelaunches the matched Release product and prepares a fresh default Link scene: original codon-lab-unhandled URI, visited/echo/handoff/disabled/armed false, requests/errors 0, last absent, lastError none, relationships none, keyboard inactive. Every method has independent admission; never run the whole class on leftover state.
admission.nativeExecution: Use the existing showcase UI-test target and standard -only-testing selection under main's existing native budget. No cloud native build, simulator, native test batch, extra budget or new orchestration is authorized.
admission.provenance: Input/observer manifest hashes describe the planned cohort/instrument. Main must pair actual original SDK object/event/receiver/window/lifetime records, real timing/cancellation and OS/Linking URL-call evidence for every contact after any normal activation. Existing JS owner counters, target IDs, XCTest isEnabled and a lack of error do not prove those facts.
admission.profile: Prepared iOS P01 normal portrait with keyboard inactive, genuine native touch and current public fixture controls. Android, other applicable profiles and physical modality authority remain independently required.

observations.existingState: link-state supplies the original visited/echo/handoff/disabled/request/last/error/target/relationship/armed values. The Swift fixture parses that fixed existing format and preserves the complete original text in attachments.
observations.nativeSnapshot: Actual XCTest target label/enabled/frame and window frame plus screenshots/hierarchy are retained. No new JS mirror, event injection, native object token or made-up timing witness is introduced.
observations.sourceTier: All six unchanged LinkScene source cases are regression support only. Their original stateful fireEvent navigation-veto seam, native-model scope handshakes and Linking spies remain source-only; they do not qualify installed input or URL handoff.
